title: Apple's Upbeat Outlook Overshadowed by Margin Squeeze

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman discusses how demand for the company's new iPhone Duo and sales of other phones could impact Apple. He speaks with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AllianceBernstein’s Yu Urges Investors to Diversify Beyond AI
snippet: Investors who rode the technology rally this year should look beyond the biggest tech stocks as growing doubts about the artificial intelligence boom rattle markets, says AllianceBernstein’s head of equities Nelson Yu.
